topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Group code of conduct and annual security acknowledgments; sanctions procedure (POL-01 4.9)
Board risk committee oversees cyber risk quarterly; board audit committee oversees internal audit
Group CISO and division security and compliance leads with defined reporting lines (POL-01)
Role-based training; security staff certifications tracked
Policy owners and risk owners named; risk acceptance authority by level (POL-01 4.4)
Asset and data inventories; SIEM data sources

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies and supplements published on the intranet; annual acknowledgment
Customer agreements and service descriptions
gap: No SOC 2 system description and no written service commitments and system requirements for the dosimetry service
remediation: Write the system description and principal service commitments (processing turnaround, dose report accuracy, confidentiality, incident notice within 72 hours)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Group and division risk objectives in POL-01 and the risk method (P01)
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up
Fraud and insider risk considered in the registers (GR-10)
Major changes trigger risk review and 73.58 screening where relevant (POL-01 4.8)
Group internal audit assesses common controls annually and samples divisions (P07)
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported to the board risk committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 High baseline and the common control catalog
General IT controls through SYS-G1 to SYS-G3

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Group policies with division supplements

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Workforce access through SYS-G1 with MFA; customers through the customer identity service
evidence: Portal authentication settings; P07 IA-8 result
gap: Customer administrator accounts sign in with a password only (POAM-013)
remediation: MFA for customer administrators, then all users

control_description: Joiner-mover-leaver workflow with approvals
Role-based access; quarterly certification
Badge-controlled offices and data centers; provider data centers carved out
Media sanitization service with certificates

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Dosimetry workload in the group landing zone; laboratory network for readers and processors
gap: Laboratory network is connected to the corporate network without a controlled boundary (ER-005)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for all transfers; DLP for regulated markings

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all endpoints and servers

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability scanning and configuration monitoring

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: 24x7 SOC monitoring with SIEM and EDR
SOC triage and severity scale (POL-03 4.2)
Group incident response plan and notification matrix (P08)
gap: Customer 72-hour notice and Florida third-party agent duty are not in the group matrix (POAM-011)
remediation: Matrix rows and a dosimetry customer notice procedure

control_description: Restores from immutable backups in provider B
gap: Quarterly restore test planned but not yet performed in 2026
remediation: Quarterly restore test of the dosimetry system and records

control_description: Change control for the laboratory information system and dose algorithms under the NVLAP quality system
gap: Algorithm changes are validated under the NVLAP quality system, but approvals are not linked to the group change records the auditor will test (ER-007)
remediation: Link quality system validation to change tickets

control_description: BIA and contingency plans (P05)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor security reviews; SOC report reviews (POL-01 4.10)
evidence: Vendor files; background vendor SOC 2 review

control_description: Capacity monitoring for the dosimetry system and portal
Immutable backups of dose records in a separate provider account
Recovery plan for dose processing (BIA BP-ER01: RTO 24 hours)
gap: Single production environment; no recovery test against the 24-hour RTO

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Dose records and personal information classified Confidential (POL-04); encrypted; access by role
Return or destruction of customer records at contract end
gap: Destruction at contract end is manual, with no certificate to the customer
remediation: Automated deletion with a certificate; retention per each customer's 20.2106 needs

control_description: Processing objectives defined in the NVLAP quality system (dose ranges, radiation types, turnaround)
Dosimeter receipt, chain of custody, and customer data validation
Processing with calibrated readers; algorithm validation; NVLAP proficiency testing
gap: Proficiency and validation evidence exists but is not mapped to processing integrity criteria (ER-007)
remediation: Map NVLAP checks to PI1.3 and PI1.4 controls

control_description: Dose reports reviewed before release; corrections tracked
Stored dose records protected from alteration and backed up
